faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.content:
What is ZXAION VERSE?

ZXAION VERSE is a platform for high-quality wallpapers and visual compositions from artists worldwide. We curate the best digital art for your devices.

How do I download images?

For most categories, you can download images for free by clicking the download button on any image. For DTREASURE premium content, you need credits.

How do credits work?

1 download = 10 credits. Once you spend credits on a DTREASURE image, you can download it again for free anytime. Lifetime PRO gives unlimited access to all DTREASURE content.

Can I use these images commercially?

DTREASURE images include commercial use rights. Other categories are for personal use only unless otherwise specified. Always check the license for each image.

copyright.title: Copyright Information
copyright.content:
All images displayed on ZXAION VERSE are the property of their respective creators. We respect intellectual property rights and work with artists to showcase their work.

If you believe your work has been used without permission, please contact us immediately at zxaionxl@gmail.com with proof of ownership.

We will respond to all legitimate copyright claims within 48 hours and take appropriate action.

dmca.title: DMCA Notice
dmca.content:
If you are a copyright owner and believe that any content on this website infringes your copyright, please send a DMCA takedown notice to zxaionxl@gmail.com with the following information:

  • Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed
  • Identification of the material that is claimed to be infringing
  • Your contact information (address, telephone number, email)
  • A statement that you have a good faith belief that use of the material is not authorized
  • A statement that the information in the notification is accurate
  • Your physical or electronic signature

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
Usage Terms

By using ZXAION VERSE, you agree to not redistribute or claim ownership of downloaded content. All images remain the property of their respective creators.

Credits & Purchases

Credits purchased are non-refundable. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue services at any time. Lifetime PRO access is valid for the lifetime of the service.

Account Responsibility

You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account. We use browser tokens for identification - clearing your browser data will reset your credits balance visibility.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
We value your privacy. Here's what we collect:

  • A unique user token stored locally in your browser to track your credits and purchased images
  • Anonymous view and download statistics for images
  • We do NOT collect: Personal information, email addresses, passwords, or payment details (handled by PayPal)

Your data is stored securely and never shared with third parties.
